**User story:** As a <who>, I want <what>, so that <why>.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] <a check anyone can verify, such as "Unknown project returns 404">
- [ ] <another check>

## Tasks

- [ ] <a step of the work>

## Definition of done

- [ ] Every acceptance criterion is checked.
- [ ] Work is on a branch named `<area>/<issue number>-<short-name>`.
- [ ] The pull request says `Closes #<this issue>` and a teammate was asked to review it.
- [ ] Checks pass (backend: pytest, ruff, mypy; frontend: `npm run lint` and `npm run build`).
- [ ] README, changelog, or API docs are updated if a route, setting, or command changed.
